No decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project, so no format is specified here. This document should be updated once a decision is made and recorded.

cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded, and it names no format.

Muninn has no recorded decision on serialisation format. Two session excerpts (#15 and #16) mention msgpack and then CBOR, but they are only transcript excerpts, not decisions, so I didn't treat either as current. The only wire-related decision on record is #5, which switched compression to zstd. That is compression, not serialisation format, so I left it out.

If you want CBOR (or anything else) stated as the policy, tell me and I'll update the file.
